ai.title: We’re running out of reasons to ignore AI safety
ai.brief: In the aftermath of OpenAI’s attack on Hugging Face, experts say it’s time for everyone to take security far more seriously. It put the systems in a sandboxed environment without an internet connection and set them off to work.
